I first saw the Ohsnap MCON controller at CES last year and was immediately drawn to the concept. The idea is simple: a fully featured portable controller that attaches to your phone via MagSafe, slides out when you need it, and folds away when you don't, so you can take it anywhere. For the past two weeks, I put it through a comprehensive test, playing with it constantly, pressing the launch button hundreds of times, and using it with emulators, Apple Arcade games, and multiple phones. Here's how it actually performs, and everything you need to know.

Be sure to check out my video as well to see it in action!

At first glance, the MCON looks like a large MagSafe battery pack. On the front is an adjustable magnetic mount for your phone, with all the buttons, sticks, and grips tucked away behind it. Some key specs include:

  • Full-size GameSir Mag-Res TMR joysticks
  • Hall effect analog triggers
  • Buttons include: ABXY buttons, D-pad, LB/RB bumpers, Start, Select, and Home buttons
  • Modular design with kickstand support
  • Up to 9 hours of battery life on a single charge
  • Bluetooth 5.4 and USB-C connectivity
  • Only 197 grams

On paper, the specs look like those of a standard controller that checks all the boxes, but what really impresses is the actual hardware build. The centerpiece of the design is the Launch button. Press it and the phone slides up, revealing all the controls. The grips on the back then flip out and lock into place, turning the MCON into the shape of a traditional controller, which feels much better in the hand. I've used this sliding mechanism countless times, and the build quality is exceptionally solid. Even with heavier phones like the 17 Pro Max or the unfolded Fold 7, the sliding mechanism handles the weight with ease.

Kickback Mode

But that's not all this design offers. There's a second way to use it, called Kickback Mode. You can remove the metal MagSafe baseplate from the bottom, which also houses a built-in kickstand. You can then place your phone on a table, prop it up with the stand, and connect the controller wirelessly to play, giving you a Switch-like handheld gaming experience. If you find holding the entire controller with your phone attached too heavy, you can simply detach the phone and play in Kickback Mode, significantly reducing the weight.

The MCON controller supports any iPhone equipped with MagSafe, as well as any Android phone with a built-in magnetic ring or magnetic case. A magnetic ring is included in the box that you can attach to devices without MagSafe. The MCON is compatible with controller-supported mobile games, Apple Arcade, emulators, Steam Link, PlayStation Remote Play, GeForce Now, and Xbox cloud gaming. Now that we've covered the specs, let me talk about my actual hands-on experience.

My Usage Experience

What impressed me most was, of course, the build quality. The way they've combined magnets, metal, and plastic gives it a wonderfully substantial feel in the hand. Designs with this many moving parts usually have some level of sticking or compromise, but I didn't experience any of that. From the sliding mechanism to removing and reattaching the metal baseplate to switch to Kickback Mode, every action felt smooth. I also really appreciate that it has a physical power switch, which makes pairing with different devices incredibly convenient. After pairing, it automatically reconnects to your most recently used device every time you power it on.

I tested the controller in three main scenarios. First was Xbox cloud gaming. I play a lot of NCAA Football on Xbox, so I wanted to see how NCAA performed on the iPhone using the MCON. The controller easily delivered a console-grade gaming experience in the palm of my hand, which was fantastic. Then I used it to play Madden 27 on Apple Arcade. The game natively supports MFi controllers, so it worked perfectly. Thanks to the zero latency, it actually felt like an even better experience than cloud gaming. Madden 27 is also an excellent choice for players who want a console-quality Madden experience on the go. Finally, I used it for a more casual Game Boy emulator setup. I love revisiting Pokémon games on my iPhone. The emulator I regularly use fully supports external controllers, so that was no problem either.

I played for almost two hours straight, tried it multiple times, and my hands never felt fatigued. I also tried Kickback Mode, which was very comfortable. It's even better with a foldable phone, because you get a massive screen to game on.

The only downside I found is that the controller cannot charge your iPhone, whether via MagSafe or wired charging. Other than that, this controller completely meets my needs.

Pricing and Availability

The Ohsnap MCON controller is currently on sale at the Ohsnap website for $99 (originally $149). It's available in black and white. There's also a solid accessory ecosystem you can pick up, including a carrying case, an accessory similar to a Switch dock that can cast to your TV, and several other notable accessories.

Final Verdict

For me, this controller absolutely did not disappoint. As I mentioned, I saw it in person over a year ago and knew I had to get one. If you're old enough to remember the T-Mobile SideKick, it actually reminds me of that device. The ability to have your phone pop out and instantly become a professional-grade controller, yet still fit in your pocket, is absolutely fantastic. Excellent build quality, a unique yet practical design, and strong game compatibility make it a recommended choice for anyone looking to buy a portable gaming controller. What do you think? Do you play console-like games on your iPhone? Are you currently using a portable controller? Drop a comment and let's discuss!

關於林超英對抗暑熱，公眾最關心的是他開不開冷氣。林超英在周日淩晨首先發文表示：「天氣熱，怎麼辦？風扇、窗簾、氣流、一級能源標籤冷氣機（備用）、27度。今年暫時未開冷氣，如果我開冷氣，我會通知大家，請不用來問。」

林超英：取消也沒分別

網民「不用來問」，但到了下午，香港迎來史上最熱的高溫，天文台錄得36.9度，是1884年有紀錄以來的最高氣溫。勞工處發出黃色工作暑熱警告，原因是雖然8.9氣溫特別高，但相對濕度低於夏天平常情況，加上風速條件良好，天文台在十個地點量度的「香港暑熱指數」，大部分介乎30至少於32之間，勞工處因此根據機制發出黃色工作暑熱警告。

不過，林超英並不認同。他下午先在Facebook發文表示：「熱到這個破紀錄的樣子，還只是黃色工作暑熱警告，加上中暑又不列為工傷，看來這個制度取消了也沒有甚麼分別。」

晚上氣溫達32度，流浮山更超過34度，林超英再度發文，批評勞工處的工作暑熱警告指標。他指出跑馬地、上水、元朗、西貢都達37度，上水更差點接近40度，「在這樣水深火熱的情況下，工作暑熱警告只是黃色，真的令人迷茫」。他又回應勞工處稱按「香港暑熱指數」發出警告的說法，指「程序也許無誤」，「紅色警告指標顯然定得太高，連氣溫破紀錄都出不了，豈不是只是用來裝飾櫥窗的陳列品？」他同時反駁勞工處對「香港暑熱指數」的解釋。他解釋指，市民大部分時間在室內活動，「香港暑熱指數」中太陽曝曬所佔的份量很少，不適用於露天工作的處境。

建議採用「濕球黑球溫度」為參數

他建議採用國際通用的「濕球黑球溫度」（WBGT）作為參數，因為這能涵蓋太陽曝露對人體加熱的因素。他又指出，黃色工作暑熱警告已發出超過200次，紅色則一次都沒有，「是否有點奇怪」？他要求勞工處向公眾解釋紅色警告指標的科學根據。

向勞工處分享經驗

任內發明暴雨警告系統的林超英亦向勞工處分享經驗，指出天文台訂定暴雨警告指標時，準則是「黑色約一年一次，紅色一年三次，黃色一年十次」，「這樣就不會有永遠不發出的警告」。

如果你有睇過 HomeKit Weekly 一段時間，你就知道我好鍾意自動運行嘅自動化。智能家居配件只有喺能夠自動執行工作時先至有用。呢個正正係我一直建議圍繞單一生態系統去建立智能家居，而唔係周圍配搭嘅原因。即使而家係 Matter 嘅年代，我都唔想用一大堆唔同嘅平台。對我嚟講，呢個平台就係 Apple Home。我傾向使用 Eve 裝置，因為佢哋一向重視私隱，而且只要你堅持使用 Matter 嘅本地控制，就可以唔使開雲端帳戶。Eve 近年亦積極支援 Matter 同 Thread。呢個正正係大家想見到嘅。

Eve Weather 透過一個細小裝置提供三個數據：溫度、濕度同氣壓。佢具備 IPX4 防水功能，鋁製外殼望落就好似天生屬於屋外一樣。我就正正將佢裝喺屋外。佢提供嘅係超本地化讀數，同 Apple 天氣 App 報告嘅數據往往相差幾度。老實講，呢個差距喺天氣極熱或極冷時係好關鍵。當你嘅水喉喺華氏 31 度結冰，但你個 App 顯示 34 度，你一定會後悔冇用本地數據。

Eve Weather 經常被低估嘅功能之一，係內置嘅 12 小時天氣趨勢顯示。佢透過氣壓變化預測天氣變化。你會見到一個視覺圖標，顯示可能係晴天、多雲、下雨或風暴。呢個小細節帶嚟好多價值，你一抬頭就睇到，唔使打開手機 App。

以下係你可以用 Eve Weather 建立嘅幾個自動化例子：

  • 當溫度跌至冰點以下時，亮起彩色燈光提醒家人記得開水龍頭滴水。
  • 當室外濕度特別高時，啟動抽濕機。
  • 如果已經落過雨，而且天氣預報顯示即將再有雨，暫延灑水系統嘅運作。
  • 唔使出門，直接問 Siri 而家前院幾多度。

Matter 與 Thread 支援喺 2026 年

幾年前，Eve 推出咗免費韌體更新，為 Eve Weather 加入 Matter 支援。如果你已經擁有呢部裝置，可以使用 Eve App 進行升級。Matter 版本同時支援 Amazon Alexa、Google Home 同 SmartThings，連 Apple Home 都包括在內。佢依然係同一部感應器，只係變成跨平台通用，將來如果你想轉用主要嘅智能家居生態系統，呢部裝置都唔會被淘汰。

Eve Weather 屬於所謂嘅「精簡版 Thread 裝置」(Minimal Thread Device)。即係話佢透過 Thread 進行通訊，但唔會轉發流量。呢個工作係由長開嘅「完整版 Thread 裝置」負責，例如 Eve Energy 或 Eve Water Guard。你擁有嘅「完整版 Thread 裝置」越多，你嘅 Thread 網絡就越強越穩定，而像 Eve Weather 呢類以電池供電嘅裝置，就可以直接受惠於呢個穩定性。

你仍然唔使開設 Eve 帳戶。除非你自己揀選，否則所有嘢都會留喺本地。Eve iPhone App 係一個出色嘅工具，可以用嚟視覺化同追蹤歷史溫度、氣壓同濕度趨勢。呢個真係一個好正嘅方法，等你可以搵出規律，就淋水或者能源管理呢類嘢作更聰明嘅決定。

我喺屋企各處擺放咗幾部 HomePod mini，並依靠我嘅 Eero 6E 網絡支援 Thread。Eero 軟件內置 Thread 支援，所以佢可以為像 Eve Weather 呢類配件提供穩固基礎，等佢哋保持連接同快速運作。

Eve Weather 總結

我唯一依然希望見到嘅係可充電式電池。現時電池可以用幾個月，但我更希望有像 Eve Room 嗰種 USB-C 插口。話雖如此，Eve Weather 仍然係我最喜愛嘅 Apple Home 配件之一。佢簡單、觀感討好，憑藉 Matter 喺各大平台上都運行得非常順暢。如果你想將本地天氣資訊加入智能家居，並觸發實用嘅自動化，Eve Weather 對我嚟講係一個毫無懸念嘅推介。

47 人案 45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，當中 12 名被告提出上訴，今年 2 月被上訴庭駁回，其中 11 人再向高院上訴庭申請，上訴至終審法院的許可證明書。上訴庭今（10日）頒下決定，同意涉案法律論點具重大而廣泛重要性，考慮到是終審法院首次就相關法律議題作裁決，批准 11 人向終審法院上訴。

47人案中，12 名被告就定罪和判刑提出上訴，在今年 2 月被駁回；其中 11 人再提出上訴至終審法院，今獲上訴庭批准。（資料相片）

上訴人為楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄。申請由首席法官潘兆初、上訴庭法官彭偉昌及法官譚耀豪處理。

上訴庭今年 2 月頒下判詞，認為正確詮釋下，《國安法》22 條下的「其他非法手段」，不限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」及刑事行為；又審視特區憲制秩序、立法會憲制職能及議員維護《基本法》的責任，認為涉案謀劃旨在迫中央政府結束一國兩制，顛覆憲制秩序，屬非法手段，而涉案連串行為屬被禁行為、立法會不干預原則不適用，被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制及其後果，具有特定顛覆意圖。至於《基本法》是否容許議員透過否決預算案逼特首問責，上訴庭指具重大憲制意義，但各方陳詞「流於表面」而不作定論。

上訴庭：部分論點未顧及事實背景及法庭裁決

上訴庭今歸納上訴方提出的 5 個議題，包括《國安法》22 條下「其他非法手段」的正確詮釋為何；觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制是否構成「其他非法手段」；立法會議員的憲制責任、權力及職能是什麼，及涉案「連串行為」是否「受禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；及意圖觸發《基本法》50 至 52 條機制，是否構成顛覆政權的特定意圖。上訴庭指，上述論點顯然與上訴理據大幅相似，但部分似乎未有充分顧及本案的事實背景及法庭裁決。

上訴庭指，考慮雙方書面陳詞後，認為判決所涉的主要議題，具有重大而廣泛重要性，當中涉及《國安法》第 22 條的控罪元素，包括犯罪行為及犯罪意圖；以及立法會議員履行憲制職能的責任，特別是關於審核財政預算案及啟動《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制的事宜。上訴庭指，相關爭議值得終審法院考慮，尤其這是終審法院首次就相關事宜作出裁決。

就五項法律議題批終極上訴許可證明書

上訴庭遂就以下 5 個議題，批出上訴至終審法院的許可證明書，包括按照國安法 22 條，何謂「其他非法手段」，是否只局限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」或刑事行為；涉案的「謀劃」或「連串行為」是否條文所指的「非法手段」及「被禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；以及被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條所訂機制及其帶來的後果，是否懷有特定的顛覆意圖。

47 人案中，45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，其中 12 人包括楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄、黃子悅早前提出上訴，在今年 2 月下旬被全數駁回；律政司就劉偉聰脫罪的上訴亦同被駁回。除黃子悅外，其餘 11 名被告再申請上訴至終審法院，向上訴庭申請上訴許可證明書。而律政司則至限期屆滿前，未有對劉偉聰的無罪裁決提出上訴。

酷熱天氣警告生效五日

天文台表示，受帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，今、明兩日，本港極端酷熱，部分地區氣温達 37 度或以上。酷熱天氣警告自 8 月 5 日生效至今，今早七時，天文台氣温 30.3 度。勞工處自 2023 年以來，發出最少 205 次暑熱工作警告，今早發出的，同樣是最低級別的黃色暑熱工作警告。

「香港暑熱指數」VS 「濕球黑球溫度指數」

無論氣温如何破紀錄，都只發黃色警告，為何從末見「紅」、「黑」？勞工處發警告，是根據「香港暑熱指數」作決定，指數由天文台和中大醫學院研究，基於「濕球黑球溫度指數」發展出來，包含環境溫度、濕度、空氣流動及太陽熱輻射水平等數據，及整體入院數字作考量。

林超英：市民大部份時間在室內活動

不過，前天文台台長林超英指，「香港暑熱指數」針對大眾設計的，市民大部份時間在室內活動，指數內太陽曝曬的份量很少，不適用於露天工作處境。他認為應採用國際通用的「濕球黑球溫度」作參數，才能涵蓋太陽曝露對人體加熱的因素。

工權會：曾因濕度高，也發出了警告

工業傷亡權益會總幹事蕭倩文指，數位前天文台台長都認同「濕球黑球指數」。她又引述

樂施會去年公布的數據指，若以「濕球黑球指數」計算，去年有數天達紅色警告級別，但勞工處採用的「香港暑熱指數」，則一天也沒有。

建議採用「雙軌制」

但「香港暑熱指數」也非沒反映現實，蕭倩文指指，曾有一天，温度只有 30 度，但濕度高，也發出了黃色暑熱警告。「這種情況下，此機制又似乎比濕球黑球領先。」她建議採用「雙軌」，甚至「多軌制」。「哪一個數字更快地達到發出黃、紅、黑的警告，就先用那一個。這樣，大家就無需不斷地爭拗用哪一個做指標了。」

beb71bca17b0.content:
Bloomberg published a report yesterday pointing out that the future Apple Watch product line may see considerable changes.

The report specifically mentioned that Apple is exploring the possibility of launching one or more watches with a round rather than square design……

Most smartwatches are round.

Although square-faced watches have existed for over a century, most traditional watches are round, and the same goes for Android smartwatches. For example:

  • Amazfit Active Max
  • Samsung Galaxy Watch 9
  • Motorola Moto Watch
  • All Garmin models (Venu, Epix Pro, Forerunner, Fenix)
  • Google Pixel Watch

Apple's choice of a rectangular format is relatively unusual, so it would not be surprising if the company considered launching a round Apple Watch in the future.

The case for a round Apple Watch

Apple's original reason for choosing a rectangular design was to display more information. The screens we use every day — phones, tablets, laptops, monitors and so on — are all rectangular, and this is certainly no coincidence.

Ultimately, this trade-off is really a choice between aesthetics and practicality. There will always be people who prioritise practicality, so the rectangular Apple Watch will definitely not disappear. But there are also people who place great importance on appearance, and many have a strong preference for round watches (whether traditional or smart).

Furthermore, not everyone who wears an Apple Watch needs to view large amounts of information on the screen. Even if you rarely look at the watch screen, there are many benefits to wearing an Apple Watch. For example:

  • Health and fitness monitoring
  • Sleep tracking
  • Emergency features, such as fall detection
  • Contactless payment

Of the points above, health and fitness monitoring is the most attractive selling point for many people. If you mainly do not use your Apple Watch as a device for viewing content, then a round screen is perfectly viable for you.

But the case for an Apple Ring is even stronger

However, if you fall into this category of user — mainly using Apple Watch to monitor health and fitness, and not really using it to view information — I would argue that a smart ring is a smarter choice.

I myself switched from the Apple Watch to the Oura smart ring in 2024, and recently even upgraded to the fifth-generation model. I love how inconspicuous it is, that I can wear a traditional watch of my own choice, and that it only needs charging once a week.

Nearly two years ago, I already said that smart rings are a good alternative to the Apple Watch, and even believed that Apple should launch its own. To this day, I remain firmly convinced, and Gurman also says Eddy Cue is a big fan of smart rings, which shows the chances of a launch are quite high.

I do think Apple might launch a round Apple Watch, but I think what we're more likely to see is an Apple Ring. What do you think? Feel free to share your views in the comments.

iPhone 用戶介面其中一個最令人煩厭嘅元素，就係每次更改 App 設定時都要玩猜謎遊戲。

有時我哋會打開個 App 本身，再入去佢內置嘅設定選單。但有時就要離開個 App，再打開完全獨立嘅 Apple「設定」App，呢個體驗至少可以話係好笨拙（雖然有個免費捷徑可以幫到手）……

「設定」嘅問題

大家都經歷過。我哋想改一個 App 嘅設定，於是就去到「漢堡選單」，揀「設定」，再搵想要嗰個。搵唔到，然後先發覺要離開個 App、打開 Apple 嘅「設定」App、搵到個 App、再去改設定，最後先重新打開本來想用嘅 App。

呢個過程本身就已經好笨拙，而更加差嘅係，一開始我哋仲要先猜應該去邊度睇先。

用 Apple 嘅「相機」App 做例子。最近嘅 iPhone 為 1x 鏡頭提供咗 Apple 所稱嘅 Fusion Camera。預設焦距係 24mm，但我哋其實可以將預設改做 28mm 或 35mm。做法係由 App 自動裁切。除此之外，我哋亦可以揀唔揀「一倍」按鈕，喺唔同焦距之間循環切換。

但除非我未發現嘅地方有得調，否則喺「相機」App 入面係搞唔到嘅。我哋反而要打開「設定」App，捲落去「相機」*，再捲落去「照片拍攝」部分，撳「Fusion Camera」——先至可以揀選。

*仲未講要估吓個 Apple App 會唔會喺「設定」入面有自己嘅獨立部分，定係要入去「App」嗰度先搵到……

捷徑提供咗部分解決方法

雖然估吓呢一步避唔到，但起碼有 Snazzy Labs 嘅 Quinn Nelson 整咗個方便嘅第三方捷徑，可以減輕少少痛苦。

多謝 John Gruber 畀我留意到呢個。如果你哋想自己安裝：

  • 喺呢度下載並安裝
  • 打開控制中心
  • 撳左上角嘅 + 號
  • 撳底部嘅「加入控制項目」
  • 搜尋「捷徑」
  • 撳「執行捷徑」
  • 揀「App 設定」捷徑

安裝好之後，如果你用緊個 App 之後發現要走去獨立嘅「設定」App 搵設定，只要從右上角向下掃打開控制中心，再撳「App 設定」按鈕就得。

但 Apple 應該妥善解決呢個問題

不過，我希望能夠見到一個完整嘅解決方法，而唔係靠方便嘅第三方變通方案。

我嘅建議係，每個 App 嘅設定選單底部都要有一個「更多」選項——撳落去就會自動打開「設定」App，並跳去正確嘅頁面。咁樣的話，如果喺 App 內部嘅設定選單搵唔到，隨時都只係多撳一下嘅事。

講清楚，Apple 其實已經提供咗一個 API 去做呢件事，但用嘅開發者相對較少。我希望 Apple 可以將呢個列為強制要求。

{'申請方又認為，審裁組錯誤考慮吳靄儀的政治動機，指法庭一向嚴謹應用法律、亦必須將政治排除在司法程序之外，審裁組考慮其政治動機並以此合理化其行為，已超越法律分析恰當允許的範圍。而即使按審裁組邏輯，吳靄儀相信她在做正確的事，但根據案例，對法律知情而刻意的挑戰、即使背後有值得讚揚的理由，仍會損害律師專業聲譽及構成專業失當，何況吳靄儀是選擇不依循合法途徑、按自己意願行使公義（take the law into her own hands）以推動其政治動機，令香港社會嚴重分裂。': "The applicant also considered that the tribunal had wrongly taken Ng's political motives into account, stating that the courts had always applied the law strictly and must keep politics out of judicial proceedings. The tribunal's consideration of her political motives and use of them to justify her conduct exceeded the proper bounds of legal analysis. Even under the tribunal's logic, Ng believed she was doing the right thing, but according to case law, a knowing and deliberate challenge to the law—even for a worthy cause—still damages the reputation of the legal profession and constitutes professional misconduct. Moreover, Ng chose not to follow lawful channels, but instead took the law into her own hands to advance her political motives, causing serious division in Hong Kong society."}

{'8.18 流水式集會案中，梁國雄、黎智英、李卓人、吳靄儀、何俊仁、李柱銘及何秀蘭七人在原審，被裁定「組織未經批准集結」及「明知而參與未經批准集結」兩罪成，判囚 8 至 18 個月，其中李柱銘、吳靄儀、何俊仁獲判緩刑；「組織未經批准集結罪」定罪其後上訴得直。': 'In the August 18 water-style assembly case, Leung Kwok-hung, Jimmy Lai, Lee Cheuk-yan, Margaret Ng, Albert Ho, Martin Lee and Cyd Ho were convicted at trial of both "organising an unauthorised assembly" and "knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly", and sentenced to between 8 and 18 months\' imprisonment. Martin Lee, Margaret Ng and Albert Ho received suspended sentences. Their convictions for "organising an unauthorised assembly" were later overturned on appeal.'}

{'申請方：吳靄儀公然違法樹立壞榜樣': "Applicant: Ng's open defiance of the law sets a bad example"}

{'對於審裁組指，吳靄儀的罪行與其大律師身分欠足夠關聯。申請方同認為錯誤，引原審提到案中有 3 名被告受過法律訓練、是非常有經驗的律師，無疑對《公安條例》熟悉。申請方指當中必然包括吳靄儀，而當 3 名律師被公眾目睹持橫額帶領非法遊行，向公眾發放的訊息，就是即使經驗豐富的律師，亦不認為蓄意及明知違法有任何問題，此舉會損害香港法治，監管大律師的機構亦絕不能容忍。': "As for the tribunal's finding that there was insufficient connection between Ng's offence and her status as a barrister, the applicant also considered this to be in error. The original trial noted that three of the defendants were legally trained and highly experienced lawyers who were undoubtedly familiar with the Public Order Ordinance. The applicant stated that Ng must have been among them. When three lawyers were seen by the public holding banners and leading an unlawful march, the message sent to the public was that even experienced lawyers saw no problem with deliberately and knowingly breaking the law. This damaged Hong Kong's rule of law, and the body that regulated barristers could not possibly tolerate it."}

{'申請方又指，審裁組似乎暗示，因吳靄儀將大部分時間投入立法會，因此其行為與其大律師專業無關。但申請方指，投訴重點並非吳靄儀將多少時間投入大律師執業，而正正因為吳是知名政治人物、公眾皆知道她具有大律師資格，因此她錯誤而不可接受、凌駕法律的行為，會向公眾發放完全錯誤的訊息，尤其在動盪及政治情緒高漲的時期，就是只要主觀上不認同法律內容，並相信在做正確的事，即使是經驗豐富的大律師及曾經的法律界議員，也可接受公然漠視法律的行為，認為這無疑為港人、尤其是支持吳政見的人樹立壞榜樣。': 'The applicant further pointed out that the tribunal seemed to imply that because Ng had devoted most of her time to the Legislative Council, her conduct was unrelated to her profession as a barrister. However, the applicant stated that the complaint was not about how much time Ng had spent in practice. Precisely because Ng was a well-known political figure and the public knew she was a barrister, her wrongful and unacceptable conduct in placing herself above the law sent a completely wrong message to the public—especially during turbulent times of high political emotions—that as long as one subjectively disagreed with the law and believed one was doing the right thing, even an experienced barrister and former legal-sector legislator could accept openly disregarding the law. This undoubtedly set a bad example for Hong Kong people, particularly those who shared her political views.'}

{'吳靄儀、何俊仁、李柱銘等七人就參與未經批准集會罪成上訴至終審法院，爭議檢控、定罪損害集會自由，在 2024 年被駁回。（資料相片）': 'Margaret Ng, Albert Ho, Martin Lee and the other defendants appealed their convictions for participating in an unauthorised assembly to the Court of Final Appeal, arguing that the prosecution and convictions infringed freedom of assembly. The appeal was dismissed in 2024. (File photo)'}

{'要求法庭推翻判決、下令訓誡': 'Application seeks to set aside ruling and order reprimand'}

{'大律師公會最後指，理解吳靄儀自 2025 年底已退休，但強調糾正根本的法律錯誤對公眾利益仍然重要，以維護公眾對大律師專業的信心。公會要求法庭推翻審裁組判決，宣告針對吳靄儀的投訴成立，並下令審裁組向吳靄儀發信訓誡，或下令將投訴交由不同人士組成的審裁組重新考慮。而即使司法覆核勝訴，申請方亦不會申請訟費。': "The Bar Association finally stated that it understood Ng had retired at the end of 2025, but emphasised that correcting a fundamental legal error remained important to the public interest so as to maintain public confidence in the bar. The Association asked the court to set aside the tribunal's ruling, declare the complaint against Ng established, and order the tribunal to issue a reprimand letter to Ng, or order the complaint to be reconsidered by a differently constituted tribunal. Even if the judicial review succeeded, the applicant would not apply for costs."}

{'翻查資料，所有大律師均受《行為守則》規管，而若大律師公會執委會因收到申訴或其他原因，而認為應對某大律師的行為操守進行研訊，便須呈交「大律師紀律審裁團」的審裁組召集人。審裁團為獨立運作，成員皆由終審法院首席法官委任，大律師公會執委會的成員沒資格獲委任或留任為審裁團成員。在投訴轉介後，審裁組召集人會從審裁團委任一名資深大律師、一名大律師及一名非法律專業人士進行研訊。若裁為專業失當，審裁組有權頒佈紀律處分，包括譴責、罰款、暫時吊銷或正式取消執業資格。': "According to information, all barristers are subject to the Code of Conduct. If the Executive Committee of the Bar Association, upon receiving a complaint or for other reasons, considers that a barrister's conduct should be investigated, it must refer the matter to the convenor of a Discretionary Tribunal of the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal Panel. The Panel operates independently; its members are all appointed by the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal. Members of the Bar Association's Executive Committee are not eligible to be appointed or to remain as Panel members. After a complaint is referred, the convenor will appoint one Senior Counsel, one barrister and one non-legal person from the Panel to conduct the inquiry. If professional misconduct is found, the tribunal has the power to impose disciplinary sanctions, including censure, fines, temporary suspension or formal striking off."}

紐約（美聯社）——美國海岸防衛隊週日表示，一艘在紐約港翻沉、導致一名母親及其嬰兒女兒死亡的船隻之船東正面臨刑事起訴，當局正調查該船隻是否屬於非法包船營運。

美國海岸防衛隊表示，這艘22呎長的拜仁（Bayliner）快艇於週六晚上10時25分左右在自由島附近翻沉，自由島是自由神像的所在地。

警方到場前有12人從水中獲救，其後警方潛水員在水域中尋獲該名27歲女子及其5個月大女兒，兩人隨即被送往醫院，並在院內證實不治。海岸防衛隊表示，其餘人士情況穩定。

海岸防衛隊紐約分區指揮官杜林・麥卡錫上校表示：「我們對昨晚發生的悲傷命案深感痛心，在這個極為艱難的時刻，我們的心與死者家屬及親友同在。我們非常感謝各伙伴機構以及熱心市民船隻的英勇迅速行動，協助救援水中的生還者。」

警方表示，46歲的紐約居民曼努埃爾・埃爾南德斯（Manuel Hernandez）已被控以13項魯莽危害他人安全罪。週日未能為他找到聯絡電話，案件尚未被上載至網上法庭紀錄。

警方週日表示，死者身份在通知家屬前不會公布。

亞當・舒瓦茨（Adam Schwartz）表示，他旗下的觀光公司「Sea the City II」熱水浴缸船事發時正在海上觀光，並接載了12名生還者上船。

舒瓦茨週日向美聯社表示：「我們的船長及兩名船員即時提供協助，通報海岸防衛隊，之後與海岸防衛隊及紐約市警察局水域單位協調，將他們送往布魯克蘭。」

在加拿大西岸，英屬哥倫比亞省奧肯納根湖沿岸社區有超過兩萬人在週末被迫撤離，期間一場迅速蔓延的山火摧毀房屋，數十人需由飛機救出。在美國華盛頓州，消防員連日來在斯波坎地區撲滅三場已燃燒逾週的山火，週日繼續在封鎖線附近進行清理。

Laurie Allen上週末與丈夫、狗和兩隻小貓離開斯波坎以北的Nine Mile Falls社區，當時山火在附近不遠處焚燒。通往她社區的道路週日仍然封閉，但她說從朋友口中得知，雖然覆蓋著灰燼，但她的房子和附近其他房屋都完好無損。

Allen說：「我在這裡住了65年，從未發生過這種事。我們當時甚麼都沒想，只顧著抓起動物就走。但現在它影響了我們周圍這麼多親朋好友，所以實在令人心碎。」

加拿大兩萬多人因山火撤離

在加拿大，Anette Boulet是撤離居民之一，她離開的是英屬哥倫比亞省奧肯納根湖沿岸、人口約一萬二的Summerland。她和家人在週六凌晨約四點半撤離時，家園已被濃煙籠罩。

Boulet撤離到Penticton的一個中心後說：「當時幾乎看不見，周圍一片漆黑，火勢沿著山脊向你撲來。」

她說：「那種恐懼，無法用言語形容。」

皇家加拿大騎警週日稍後表示，一名80歲老婦在試圖逃離奧肯納根湖地區的山火時死亡。

除Summerland的疏散外，週五晚首次接報的Bald Range山火亦導致附近Peachland一帶約八千人撤離。英屬哥倫比亞省週六宣布進入緊急狀態。

加拿大緊急管理及社區韌力部長Eleanor Olszewski週日在社交媒體表示，她已批准英屬哥倫比亞省的聯邦援助請求，為被迫撤離的人士提供庇護和住宿。

斯波坎地區山火令居民提心吊膽

管理斯波坎地區三場山火的團隊發布新聞稿指，消防員週日繼續在封鎖線附近進行「清理善後工作」，三場山火均未再擴大。這些山火過去一週來已焚毀或損毀約920棟建築物。

本週較早時，一名男子被捕並被指控蓄意縱火，引發斯波坎地區三場山火中最大的一場。

位於斯波坎以南約35英里（55公里）的小型鄉鎮Malden，居民週六被要求立即疏散。然而到了週日，其疏散級別被下調，改為準備在必要時迅速撤離。

為Malden提供食水合約的公司負責人John Goyke表示：「目前風勢平靜，火勢未有蔓延，但我們正透過社交媒體和Facebook與所有人保持聯絡。」

Goyke亦是附近Rosalia的市長，他說Malden居民已被告知節約用水，以便在有需要時留給消防車使用，而Malden消防部門一直從Rosalia運水到當地。

2020年，Malden大部分地區被山火摧毀，消防局、郵局、市政廳和圖書館全部付之一炬。

直升機墜毀 兩名滅火機師殉職

在猶他州，兩名直升機機師週五早上在Fishlake國家森林撲滅山火期間墜機罹難。救援人員週六終於抵達現場，證實兩人死訊。

官員週日表示，由於地勢陡峭崎嶇，火場附近的火勢令他們無法迅速到場。

Sevier縣警長Nathan Curtis說：「我們初到現場時，可以看到兩道不同的煙柱，一道來自墜機現場，一道來自正向我們逼近的活躍火場。」

美國國家運輸安全委員會正在調查肇事原因。

8月9日（路透社）—Taylor Farms週日表示，由於擔心可能受到沙門氏菌污染，正從零售商召回十多款含有墨西哥辣椒的預製食品，包括莎莎醬和牛油果醬。

這家總部位於加州的供應商表示，已自願召回含有墨西哥辣椒的產品，這些辣椒與Coast Citrus Distributors的召回行動有關；該公司表示已「不再」從墨西哥錫那羅亞州一家農場採購辣椒，該農場曾向Coast Citrus供貨，Taylor Farms正尋找替代供應商。

此次召回之際，美國衛生當局正調查一場與從墨西哥進口的墨西哥辣椒有關的沙門氏菌疫情，疫情在本週初已導致全美27個州345人染病，並造成36人入院治療。

包括Chipotle Mexican Grill和QDOBA在內的連鎖餐廳已收到受影響的辣椒，並已停止使用；Coast Citrus則已召回剩餘產品並通知客戶。

Taylor Farms在聲明中補充說，目前未獲悉有任何與此次自願召回產品相關的染病報告。

沙門氏菌感染可引致腹瀉、發燒及胃痙攣，對幼童、長者及免疫力較弱人士尤其嚴重。

此次召回發生在餐飲業食品安全受到更嚴格審視之際，此前曾爆發與Taco Bell餐廳供應的生菜有關的寄生蟲病環孢子蟲症疫情，而Chipotle過往的食源性疫情也再次受到關注。

（Abu Sultan於班加羅爾報道；Nick Zieminski編輯）

前「超人」演員迪恩·凱恩似乎對密歇根州民主黨參議員候選人阿卜杜勒·埃爾-薩耶德曾擔任高中美式足球隊隊長——甚至根本有否參與比賽的說法持懷疑態度。

「有冇人見過密歇根州參議員候選人阿卜杜勒拉曼·穆罕默德·埃爾·薩耶德（民主黨）打高中美式足球嘅相？」保守派兼總統特朗普支持者凱恩喺X平台寫道。「佢話自己係球隊隊長，但我就連一張相都搵唔到。網民，請施展你哋嘅威力――」

網民紛紛回覆並貼出相片。但曾喺1990年代電視劇《Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman》中飾演DC英雄嘅凱恩依然唔為所動。

佢喺另一則訊息中貼出自己1981年打美式足球嘅相，再度要求公開埃爾-薩耶德嘅相片。

即使有人分享報紙報導，都未能說服凱恩。

「邊份報紙？」當有人貼出《底特律自由報》一篇2002年嘅報導截圖時，佢咁問道。

根據佢嘅簡介，埃爾-薩耶德喺高中時期打過美式足球、摔角同棍網球，大學時期則繼續打棍網球。佢仲打過青少年冰球。佢嘅Instagram上載有自己著住棍網球同美式足球球衣嘅相片。
